basic_info.description: Charming Starter Home with Great Potential - This newly refreshed home is perfect for those looking for a move-in ready space with room to grow. Featuring freshly painted interiors and beautifully refinished hardwood floors, it offers a cozy and inviting atmosphere. The open layout allows you to settle in and enjoy the home as-is, while the bathroom, kitchen, and sunroom are ready for future updates to suit your style.    With a one-car garage and plenty of storage space, you'll have room to keep everything organized. The good-sized, level backyard offers a fruit tree and potential for outdoor activities or future landscaping projects. Whether you're just starting out or looking to create your dream home over time, this property offers a fantastic foundation within walking distance to shopping and transportation.
